description: This source file defines the internal class `AzureQueueBatchContainer`, which implements the `IBatchContainer` interface for handling batching of stream events in Azure Queue storage within the Orleans streaming framework. It includes properties and methods for managing stream IDs, sequence tokens, events, request context, and serialization.

classes.name: AzureQueueBatchContainer
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a batch of stream events for Azure Queue storage, implementing `IBatchContainer` interface and supporting serialization.

methods.name: AzureQueueBatchContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the batch container with stream ID, events, request context, and sequence token.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Retrieves the contained events cast to specified type along with their sequence tokens.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Imports the stored request context into the current context, if available.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the container, including stream ID and event count.
